title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Redcurrant, Grape and Cherry E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Rachael Rabbit's Redcurrant, Grape, and Cherry shortfill elegantly combines the tartness of redcurrant with the natural sweetness of grapes and the deep, satisfying taste of cherries. This e-liquid brings together a selection of flavours that are both bold and nuanced, with each fruit adding its unique character to the mix. The inclusion of an icy layer elevates the overall experience, adding a refreshing twist that makes each vape crisp and exhilarating. Packaged in a 120ml shortfill bottle, this offering includes 100ml of e-liquid, providing space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. Incorporating 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots into the mix will yield 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, allowing you to tailor the nicotine strength to your liking. Designed with a 70VG/30PG ratio, it is optimally formulated for sub-ohm vaping, ensuring a delightful balance between dense vapour production and rich, immersive flavour on any high-powered device. Opting for Rachael Rabbit shortfills not only provides a cost-effective way to enjoy exquisite flavours but also offers the advantage of nicotine strength customization. These e-liquids are ideally suited for use with advanced sub-ohm kits, meeting the needs of vapers who prefer a more intense and flavourful vaping experience. Proudly produced in the UK, Rachael Rabbit specializes in crafting intricate fruit combinations. Every e-liquid in their lineup is a testament to their commitment to quality, presenting a trio of perfectly balanced flavours for a truly exceptional and authentic fruit vape journey.
